text:
alex: FYI seeing spike in preemptions in us-west1 over last 6h — rates up ~3x vs baseline, multiple customer retries. evict-bot alerted ~120 evictions/hour.

maria: Can you paste the dashboard link? Any common instance types or zones?

alex: dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/spot-evictions (private). Mostly A2/P4d-preemptible-like shapes, short sequence workloads. Zones: us-west1-a/b primarily.

shawn: Likely provider maintenance/spot pressure. Immediate mitigations proposal: (1) soft hedging to us-east1 with fanout cap, (2) fail Gold to Dedicated, (3) low-priority -> mixed preemptible pool + model-variant fallback.

jen: +1 on hedging. Need to handle KV-cache/session stickiness — can't cold-start all chat sessions across regions.

kyle: Suggest sticky routing by customer-tier for 30s; only allow cross-region failover after 2 failed attempts. Also consider shipping last-kv prefix to fallback nodes.

maria: What's the expected cost delta? Hedging will add egress and extra token-hours.

alex: Rough numbers from a quick sim: hedging ratio 1.2 -> ~+8% token cost, but reduces tail errors by ~60%. Dedicated fallback for Gold increases committed cost but keeps SLA.

shawn: Proposed rollout plan (short):
  A) soft-hedge canary: fanout 1.2 for low-priority traffic to us-east1 (2h canary)
  B) eviction fallback: on preempt -> try same-region quantized variant (gpt-small-quant) then cross-region hot pool
  C) Gold escalation: if error_rate>5% for 10m, move Gold traffic to Dedicated pools

jen: Monitoring: add SLO alert if cross-region retries >0.5% sustained for 5m, and a cost burn notice if canary >10% cost delta.

alex: Config snippet for ops (will push as feature flag):
```
routing:
  hedging:
    ratio: 1.2
    max_fanout: 2
  fallback:
    on_eviction: [same-region-quant, cross-region-hot]
    retry_window_s: 5
    sticky_ttl_s: 30
```

shawn: Good. Also add a circuit-breaker for cross-region fanout to avoid blast radius during provider outage.

alex: Kicking off a 2h canary on dev tenants now. evict-bot will collect metrics and post a summary.

evict-bot: canary started at 1801003470. will post summary when complete.

evict-bot: summary: 43 preemptions mitigated by hedging/fallback, p95 latency +12ms, overall token-cost +7.4% for canary traffic.

kyle: Numbers look acceptable. Next steps: ops-oncall to approve Gold Dedicated escalation, update runbook + customer notice draft.

maria: I'll draft the customer notice and tag product for sign-off.

alex: thanks — will post full logs + canary graphs in thread in ~15m. :thumbsup:
